CryptoCom to Discontinue Consumer App in Hong Kong on February 1, 2027

According to Bloomberg, CryptoCom will discontinue its consumer app in Hong Kong effective February 1, 2027, citing efforts to optimize global operations and resource allocation. The company said affected users have been notified and will receive instructions on account closures and fund withdrawals. Meanwhile, CryptoCom continues to pursue a virtual asset trading platform license from Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) through Foris DAX HK Limited for its institutional-grade CryptoCom Exchange platform. —

Mercado Bitcoin confirms cyberattack, Hypernative estimates over $40M suspected losses

Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil's largest cryptocurrency exchange, confirmed on November 2 that one of its systems had suffered a cyberattack. The exchange said the incident was quickly contained, customers would not incur losses, and no customer data had been leaked. Deposits and withdrawals have been temporarily suspended as a precaution. Tether said it has frozen more than 4.5M USDT related to this security incident.

BitMine adds 8,573 ETH, holdings reach 6.06M ETH

BitMine said it acquired 8,573 ETH over the past week, bringing total holdings to 6,060,506 ETH, or about 4.9% of Ethereum’s supply. The company has 5,227,037 ETH staked, while total crypto, cash, marketable securities and other investments stand at about $14.5 billion, including $498 million in cash and marketable securities. — link

Strategy buys 811 BTC for $65.5M, holds 849,327 BTC total

According to an SEC Form 8-K filed on November 2, Strategy purchased 811 BTC for approximately $65.5 million between October 26 and November 1, at an average price of $80,846 per BTC. As of November 1, the company held 849,327 BTC, acquired for a total of approximately $64.08 billion at an average cost of $75,451 per BTC.

ZachXBT: EU entity suspected of losing over $106M in crypto theft

On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported on November 2 that an EU-based entity is suspected of losing more than $106 million from multiple centralized exchange accounts on November 1. The suspected attacker withdrew the funds in USDC and USDT and has since been actively swapping USDC for ETH, transferring assets through instant exchange services including WellWallet and Kyrrex, converting funds into privacy coin XMR via Wagyu, and bridging assets across multiple blockchains. Elliptic: Binance Hacker Uses CoinJoin for First Time as 44% of Stolen Funds Are Frozen

Elliptic said laundering of the roughly $6.43 billion stolen from Binance has involved 11 blockchains, around 12,000 wallets and more than 40,000 transactions. About $2.85 billion, or 44%, has been frozen or seized, while roughly $3.24 billion remains in linked addresses. Tron was a major route, with funds spread across about 7,700 addresses; the attacker has also begun using CoinJoin, while about $16 million was sent to addresses linked to the earlier Bitget hack. — link

QCP: Bitcoin Holds $76K Support as Binance Sees $3.64B Net Outflows

QCP said Bitcoin fell to $76,141 last Friday after breaking below $80,000, but the $76,000–$76,600 range held for a fourth time. Binance has reopened withdrawals across 15 networks following the exploit, with net outflows of $3.64 billion, or about 2.1% of assets, while U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows on Friday. QCP sees support at $76,000–$76,600 and resistance at $79,500–$80,500. — link

Binance User USDT Holdings Fall 7.95% in Latest Proof of Reserves

Binance’s latest proof-of-reserves snapshot, dated October 31, shows user BTC holdings increased by 3,614 BTC, or 0.52%, to 692,187 BTC. User ETH holdings decreased by 144,217 ETH, or 3.80%, to 3,654,919 ETH; USDT holdings fell by 2,544,682,319 USDT, or 7.95%, to 29,483,062,742 USDT; and BNB holdings declined by 401,669 BNB, or 0.93%, to 42,638,276 BNB. — link

Crypto Fear & Greed Index falls to 30 after Binance hack

CryptoQuant said the Crypto Fear & Greed Index has fallen to 30, compared with a 30-day average of 56, following the October 29 Binance hack. The index had already declined from 68 on October 22 to 51 before the incident, suggesting sentiment was weakening even before the attack. CryptoQuant said a sustained recovery in both sentiment and price would be needed to confirm an improvement. — link

HashKey Cloud and Utila Form Strategic Partnership to Explore Institutional Digital Asset Infrastructure

HashKey Cloud, a Web3 infrastructure provider under HashKey Group, and Utila, a stablecoin and digital asset infrastructure platform, announced that they signed a strategic partnership agreement on November 2. The two companies will combine HashKey Cloud’s institutional staking and yield infrastructure with Utila’s stablecoin and digital asset operations infrastructure to explore institutional services covering asset yield management, payments, custody, and compliance controls. — link

Bitcoin Spot ETFs Saw $203 Million Net Outflows Last Week, Ethereum Spot ETFs Saw $432 Million Net Outflows

In the trading week from October 26 to October 30 (ET), Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded net outflows of $203 million, with Fidelity’s FBTC leading at $166 million in net outflows. Ethereum spot ETFs saw net outflows of $432 million, marking five consecutive weeks of net outflows. — link

Madagascar and US Dismantle 13 Scam Compounds, Seizing $52 Million in Cryptocurrency

According to Agence France-Presse (AFP), Madagascar law enforcement and the U.S. Department of Justice jointly dismantled 13 scam compounds in August and September this year. The operations involved romance scams, fraudulent investments, and cryptocurrency fraud. The U.S. Department of Justice said that in a single day of operations, authorities seized cryptocurrency worth approximately $52 million and more than 3,200 electronic devices.
